en.summary: Identify the current official comparison base
details: Default: current site directory. Output JSON: old, source and basis; modified reports local Git changes when available.
Use old as <old> in swban help upgrade/git. Local sources check current official refs with ls-remote and require their commit history to be available locally; no fetch is performed.
If old is null, exit 1; candidate is only a declared version. Use the target reference site to review all four roots and migrate step by step, or set up from it as a new site.

zh.summary: 识别当前官方比对起点
details: 默认检查当前站点目录。输出 JSON：old、source 和 basis；可读取本地 Git 状态时，modified 表示源码是否有改动。
将 old 用作 swban help upgrade/git 中的 <old>。本地源码用 ls-remote 核对官方当前引用，并需本地已有相应提交历史；不执行 fetch。
old 为 null 时退出码为 1；candidate 仅为声明版本。按目标版本参考站点全量核对四个根项并逐步迁移，或按新站点设置。
